mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sa_conversation (user_id, project_id, knowledge_base_id, knowledge_snapshot_id, title, mode) VALUES (#{userId}, #{projectId}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{knowledgeSnapshotId}, #{title}, #{mode})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.project_id, c.knowledge_snapshot_id, c.knowledge_base_id, c.title, c.mode, c.create_time, c.update_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sa_message m WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id AND m.user_id = c.user_id) AS message_count FROM sa_conversation c WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sa_conversation SET title = #{title} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sa_conversation WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sa_conversation SET update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
